description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kakkele, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510237
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 543) with detailed land particulars including ownership details, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
